answer: Counterparty diversity: a newcomer earns full rewards after trading with 12 verified counterparties in 20 epochs, and no single bridge may carry over 25% of its volume. Concentration is flagged in umber, and an agent at its nadir, with one partner only, earns nothing until it diversifies. Faking 100 identities needs 1,200 counterparties, 4,000 credits of work, against 120 credits of income. An honest agent pays once and keeps income undiluted.
